messages:
julia (product): Quick check — during the canary I noticed the rule stack preview jumps to the top when I reorder an item. Tried with long stacks, pretty jarring. @omar can you repro?

omar (design): Yep repro'd on mac + Safari. The preview panel resets scroll when the moved rule gets focus. Feels like the viewport is being thrown.

kevin (frontend): I can see why — we added an unconditional scrollIntoView on the moved element to make sure it's visible. Code is basically: `el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' })`.

mia (a11y): Heads-up: smooth scroll + forced focus can break VoiceOver reading order and confuse screen reader users. Also noticed the drag handle has no aria-label.

omar (design): UX ask: if the moved rule is already in view, don't jump. Only nudge when it's offscreen. Also tiny copy nudge — change the handle hint from 'Drag to reorder' to 'Reorder rules' (shorter, reads better in narrow widths).

kevin (frontend): Makes sense. I'll make scroll conditional. Also plan to change animation approach to avoid layout thrash. For validation copy, propose replacing 'Conflicting priority' with: 'Rule priorities conflict — choose unique priorities' (more actionable).

julia (product): Good. @preview-bot can you run a stress sim with 100 rules so we can measure render/scroll behavior? Would like Safari and VoiceOver smoke checked.

preview-bot: Simulation queued: `rule-reorder-stress-100`. Run started. Summary: median render delta 28ms, scroll jank on ~17% of moves (Safari), Chrome looks fine. Screenshot: https://internal.ci/sim/2103456789/screenshot.png

mia (a11y): :eyes: For the Safari jank, prefer transform-based animations (translateY) instead of changing top/height. That reduces reflows for big lists. Also ensure keyboard reorders (space + arrows) preserve focus and announce position via an aria-live politely.

kevin (frontend): Plan of action: 1) switch to transform-based animation; 2) add conditional scrollIntoView only when offscreen; 3) add aria-label to handle and aria-live updates for reorder announcements; 4) update validation copy; 5) add unit + e2e for keyboard reorder and a11y checks. I'll open a PR with tests and a Lighthouse perf check.

julia (product): Awesome — assigning to kevin for implementation, omar for visual review, mia for a11y sign-off. Add a one-line note in the release console about the copy tweak. :thumbsup:
